media.alt_text:
3 Years of The Biden-Harris Administration
- A total of $136 billion in student debt relief for over 3.7 million borrowers through various actions
- 14.3 million jobs created
- 22+ million Americans saving $30-$75 per month on their internet bills
- Delivered over $4 billion to replace lead pipes across the country 
- Over $640 billion in private sector investments in manufacturing and clean energy
- Saving millions of Americans $800 per year on health insurance
- The most significant expansion of benefits and services for toxic exposed veterans in more than 30 years 
- Unemployment rate under 4% for the longest stretch in more than 50 years
- Three strongest years on record for new business applications, with 16 million applications filed
- Protecting access to reproductive health care
- The largest investment in history to build a clean energy economy and meet our climate goals
- More executive action than any other President to reduce the trauma and tragedy of gun violence

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, the Biden-Harris Administration has acted to:
- Help ensure that women receive the care they need in an emergency 
- Protect access to safe and effective medication abortion
- Defend the right to travel for medical care
- Expand access to affordable contraception, including under the Affordable Care Act
- Strengthen privacy protections for patients and doctors
- Support access to reproductive health care for service members and veterans
- Partner with state leaders on the frontlines of protecting reproductive freedom

ReproductiveRights.gov

Annelise: President Biden, Please please do something about the insane overdraft fees banks charge. I was charged $36 three times in one week and subsequently overdrafted again BECAUSE of the fees. Why are banks punishing their hard working, middle class customers this way?!

President Biden: Annelise, I couldn’t agree more. Excessive overdraft fees are exploitation, plain and simple. My Administration proposed a rule today to cut the average overdraft fee by more than half – keeping money in your pocket, not the bank’s.
